application.name: Odoo

verification.notes: Draft only. Verify the deployed Community modules and actual image components. Example version claims 20/19/18 were not imported; upstream release availability is not proof of image availability.

deployment.accessSummary: Standard setup is completed in the browser. SSH remains available for advanced customization.
deployment.usageInstructions:
1. Launch the AMI and locate the instance's Public IPv4 address in the EC2 Console.

2. Open https://<EC2_PUBLIC_IP>:9000 and complete the Websoft9 setup wizard.

3. Use the Console to deploy the application and find its access URL.

Allow inbound TCP 80/443 for web traffic and 9000 for the Console. Additional application ports depend on the deployment configuration.

verification.notes: Verify initialization, credentials, TLS behavior, network rules and application access on the actual AMI.
